items.name: Asthma advice
items.text: The patient has been advised on asthma self-management, including recognition of deterioration and when to seek urgent medical attention. Regular preventer therapy should be continued as prescribed.

items.name: Inhaler advice
items.text: Inhaler technique was discussed. The patient was advised to use a spacer where appropriate and to rinse the mouth after using a corticosteroid inhaler.

items.name: COPD advice
items.text: COPD management was reviewed, including inhaler use, smoking cessation where relevant, and safety-netting for infective exacerbations.

items.name: Safety-netting
items.text: The patient was advised to seek urgent medical attention if they develop worsening breathlessness, chest pain, haemoptysis, or fever.

items.name: Hypertension advice
items.text: Blood pressure management was discussed, including adherence to antihypertensive medication, home monitoring if appropriate, and lifestyle measures.

items.name: Cardiovascular risk advice
items.text: Cardiovascular risk factors were reviewed. Advice was given regarding diet, physical activity, smoking cessation, and lipid management as appropriate.

items.name: Diabetes advice
items.text: Diabetes care was reviewed, including medication, monitoring, and the importance of foot, eye, and kidney screening as per usual care.

items.name: Migraine advice
items.text: Migraine triggers, acute treatment, and when to seek further review were discussed. Safety-netting advice was given for sudden or atypical headache.

items.name: Routine follow-up
items.text: Routine follow-up will be arranged. The patient should contact the surgery sooner if symptoms worsen.

items.name: No further follow-up
items.text: No further follow-up is planned from this clinic. The patient should contact their GP if new or worsening symptoms occur.
